name: The Saplum Cradle: Vertical Slice
source:
You play as Amber, a small child cared for by Asterisk, a mysterious shadowy demon who protects her from the threats that inhabit the wasteland.

[From [url=https://devroom-vantasia.itch.io/the-saplum-cradle-vertical-slice]Itch.io[/url]]
